title: The Rebuilt Athlete · Phase 00

authority.rule: The live active block and immutable planned-session versions are the running prescription source of truth. This JSON is a web review projection.

objective: Retrain automatic faster running without forcing pace. Monday extends relaxed time, Tuesday repeats 3 × 1 mile by feel, and Saturday keeps easy durability underneath it.
governing_rules: No pace target for the quicker work.
No heart-rate target for the quicker work.
Quicker running stays around a relaxed 4–5/10. Fluidity wins over the clock.
5:40/mi is a later direction, not a split to force.
When the first 5:xx appears, repeat the feeling rather than accelerating the next rep.
Saturday stays easy with no fast finish and no makeup mileage.
Progress Monday duration only when the prior Monday/Tuesday pair leaves normal recovery.
form_scope: FORM carries the running prescription and running filing. Strength remains in Speed & Form: Strength / Forge. Study 002 interprets the interaction.
authoring_context: Weeks 03 Monday and Tuesday were added after the sessions occurred so the canonical block includes this week's work and the observed deviations. Their coach-import completions preserve what actually happened; they are not represented as pre-run native app receipts.

weeks.intent: Prolong clean running by distance, with full recovery between exposures.
Hold volume. Improve aerobic control and keep the movement fluid.
Read the first faster exposures, then keep Saturday easy.
